source: cmocean (Thyng et al. 2016), doi:10.5670/oceanog.2016.66; ColorBrewer BrBG (Brewer, colorbrewer2.org) via matplotlib

temperature.note: Diverging: cooler is blue, warmer is red, no change is white.

days.note: More frost days is blue (colder), fewer is red.

rainfall.note: Diverging: drier is brown, wetter is blue-green, no change is white.

heat.note: Sequential: no heat stress is white, severe heat stress is dark red.

sealevel.note: Diverging: lower is blue, higher is red.

fishing.note: Sequential on a log scale: more fishing hours is brighter.
